title: A Treatise on Acupuncturation
author: James Morss Churchill

authorInfo.bio: James Morss Churchill (Died 1863) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.

description: "A Treatise on Acupuncturation" by James Morss Churchill is a scientific publication written during the early 19th century. This treatise aims to introduce and describe acupuncturation, a surgical operation with origins in Japanese and Chinese practices, now being integrated into European medicine.
